name:
The Westin Playa Vallarta, an All-Inclusive Resort
Accepting Bookings starting May 2026
positioning: The Westin Playa Vallarta, an All-Inclusive Resort: a beachfront all-inclusive in Marina Vallarta on Banderas Bay, with swim-up and plunge pool suites, two Pacific-view pools and a Heavenly Spa
best_for: Families and couples who want an all-inclusive beach stay in Puerto Vallarta
Travelers who want a suite with a plunge pool or swim-up access

facts.text: The beachfront resort is in Marina Vallarta, minutes from downtown Puerto Vallarta and the airport.
Suites include swim-up and private plunge pool options.
The Heavenly Penthouse is a bi-level suite with a plunge pool.
Private balconies look over Banderas Bay or the hotel grounds.
The resort uses biophilic design with lush landscapes, open-air spaces and natural light.
The resort has tennis, pickleball and padel courts.
Guests can join oceanfront yoga or a ceviche-making session.
Dining spans six restaurants in the Gourmet Gallery plus four open-air restaurants and bars.
Agave Studio in the Gourmet Gallery offers mezcal tastings.

highlights.text: The Heavenly Pool Panoramic Suite is on the top floors, with ocean views from a private balcony and a plunge pool.
The resort has two outdoor pools overlooking the Pacific.
The Presidential Suite is a top-floor retreat with a private balcony, bay and ocean views and a plunge pool.
The Heavenly Spa offers hydrotherapy with plunge pools, showers and warm water massage jets.

considerations.text: The resort is family-friendly and open to guests of all ages, so it is not an adults-only escape.
It is in Marina Vallarta rather than downtown; downtown Puerto Vallarta is minutes away.
